description: This file defines Express routes for managing weekly report data, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting reports, and a self-test endpoint. It incorporates Swagger documentation for API specifications.

methods.name: router.post('/api/reports')
methods.description: Handles creation of a new weekly report by invoking controller.create.

methods.name: router.post('/api/reports/selftest')
methods.description: Performs a self-test insert operation using selfTestController.selfTestInsert.

methods.name: router.get('/api/reports/:id')
methods.description: Retrieves a report by its ID via controller.getById.

methods.name: router.get('/api/reports')
methods.description: Lists reports, optionally filtered by userId, using controller.list.

methods.name: router.patch('/api/reports/:id')
methods.description: Updates a report partially through controller.patch.

methods.name: router.delete('/api/reports/:id')
methods.description: Deletes a report by ID via controller.remove.
